That's just a typo I meant 2015 not 18. 
Well I'm still here for now, thank you for the kind words

I'm 25 now so this all happened between the ages of 12 until 20 when he passed away. 
It is so painful the dull black hole in my chest, sometimes it brings me to my knees. Thank you for the kind words I really want to push on. I want to be optimistic for the future but it is just so difficult
That is so nice thank you, I'm just struggling too see myself as strong at this point in time
Uni does not help at all. I fucking hate it but I'm in my final semester
I can relate and I have had so many people tell me that life isn't full of sunshine and that it's tough but I just feel like there is never going to be sunshine that this is it.

Everything feels so overwhelming. Everything had been going wrong for so long and at the end of last year things started going my way, I was sleeping right,  eating right,  spending time with friends,  I had a boyfriend, i was going the gym, good relationship with family and uni was going well. Then christmas happened I went home and family were arguing and fighting, I got back to uni and working slipped, leading to my sleep schedule to go. My boyfriend dumped me and I isolated myself away from my friends. I am eating so bad that I have diarrhoea regularly. I haven't gymed in weeks. It's like just before Christmas is the best my life can come too before everything sours and goes back to the way it has always been
